name: Real estate developers and agents
description: For developers and agents selling homes and land, including to Nigerians living abroad.

intake.label: Current projects or listings
intake.help: One per line, with location. For example: Lekki Gardens Phase 2, Lekki

intake.label: Unit types and prices
intake.help: Show naira and dollar prices if you sell to buyers abroad.

intake.label: Title documents available
intake.help: For example: C of O, Governor's Consent, Registered Survey.

intake.label: Payment plans
intake.help: Deposit and how long buyers have to pay.

intake.label: How inspections work
intake.help: Physical days and times, and whether you offer virtual video inspections.

qualifiers: What budget are you working with?
Which country do you live in at the moment?
Is this to live in, rent out, or hold as an investment?
When are you hoping to buy?
Would you pay outright or prefer a payment plan?

sequences.name: New enquiry
steps: Offer a virtual or physical inspection
Share a site progress update after 7 days

adTemplates.audience: Nigerians living in the UK, US and Canada interested in property in Nigeria
adTemplates.angle: Verified title and virtual inspection before you fly in
Flexible payment plan with a fixed price

compliance: Never promise guaranteed returns or fixed resale profits.
Only state title documents the business has confirmed.
